description: Search Villiers' available empty-leg flights — heavily discounted, one-off private jet repositioning flights that are significantly cheaper than a full charter. Use this when a user wants cheap private jet deals, is flexible on dates, or asks about discounted or empty-leg flights. Optionally filter by origin, destination or region. Each result links to the specific flight to view and enquire.

date.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD. Narrows the whole list (with or without a route) to flights departing that day; with date_to it is the first day of a range. A day with no flight returns no legs plus nearest_dates. Optional.

date_to.description: Last departure date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, for a range with date (a weekend, a week). Optional. Defaults to date.

destination.description: Destination city / airport name / IATA / ICAO, e.g. Nice or NCE. Optional.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Call again with offset=next_offset from the previous response to page past the first `limit` results — see has_more/next_offset in the output.

origin.description: Origin city / airport name / IATA / ICAO, e.g. London or LHR or EGLL. Optional — mirrors destination, filters strictly on the departure side. Useful for a 'departing near me' search.

region.description: Region filter: europe / americas / asia / all. Optional.

name: search_empty_legs

date_filter.description: The inclusive date range applied, when date or date_to was given

has_more.description: True if more results exist beyond this page

nearest_dates.description: On a date miss: the nearest dates that do have a listed flight

next_offset.description: Offset to pass in the next call to continue paging; null when has_more is false

offset.description: The offset this response was generated at
